_comment: English names and effects for docs/wiki/Camp-Objects.md (tools/gen_wiki.py). Tiers, skills, replacements and class-buff exclusivity come from Campkeeper/Data/Catalog.lua; here only what the catalog does not know. Effects follow the placement spell texts of client 1.60.1; an upgrade's 'also gives the bonus of' line is added by the generator.

reagent_bot.name: Reagent Bot
reagent_bot.effect: Everyone nearby can buy reagents. No stat bonus.

repair_bot.name: Repair Bot
repair_bot.effect: Everyone nearby can buy reagents and repair gear.

anarchist_workbench.name: Anarchist's Workbench
anarchist_workbench.effect: Required to craft certain items. No stat bonus.

fishing_rack.name: Fishing Rack
fishing_rack.effect: Catch uncommon fish for 1 hour; provides fishing lures.

fishing_hut.name: Fishing Hut
fishing_hut.effect: Catch rare fish for 1 hour; provides fishing lures.

seed_hybridizer.name: Seed Hybridizer
seed_hybridizer.effect: Multiply seeds or combine them into a higher rarity.

camp_tent.name: Camp Tent
camp_tent.effect: Rested experience builds up while you rest, up to 5% of a level (Boosted Rest, once per hour).

rock_garden.name: Rock Garden
rock_garden.effect: A common ore vein appears in it after a while.

camp_chair.name: Camp Chair
camp_chair.effect: +2% critical strike chance with spells and attacks.

field_guide.name: Field Guide
field_guide.effect: Read it to gain Track Beasts.

faction_banner.name: Faction Banner
faction_banner.effect: +14 Spirit. Alliance and Horde have their own banner.

cooking_feast.name: Cookie's Feast
cooking_feast.effect: A feast of food that raises Stamina. Needs a cooking fire.

iron_oven.name: Iron Oven
iron_oven.effect: Required for the most complex dishes. Needs a cooking fire.
